issue_context.title: Capture the status message from status-type responses in audit logs
issue_context.body:
#### What happened:

If the response to a request is a `metav1.Status`, we currently copy a subset of the response to the `ResponseStatus` field of the audit logs: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/1ad3e14f1fc4a5f6e6cd6f9ffc7d030cb3d6540d/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/audit/request.go#L183-L188

Note that the message is not included. In order to capture the response message, the full `RequestResponse` audit level must be used. This is not always desireable - as a contrived example, consider the case of secret resource failing validation. For a more common case, dropping the full response object may be desireable to cut down on storage costs, but the relatively small status response still holds valuable data (e.g. admission denials) in the error case.

#### What you expected to happen:

We should always capture the full `metav1.Status` response, including the message field. I'm open to dropping the details field, but I'm not sure that's necessary.

/sig auth api-machinery
/area audit
/milestone v1.23
